ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: long hours
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Everyone works longer, harder days until the decree ends. Building, harvesting and crafting go faster, at a cost in mood. The industrious like it and hard workers don't mind; the lazy and slothful hate it.

effects.li: Most colonists resent it; the industrious and hard workers don't mind.

cheerful.li: Good! Let's get the barn finished before the weather turns.

plain.li: My back already hurts and we haven't started.
Longer days, and the same rice at the end of them.

blunt.li: Fine. I'm counting every extra hour.

gloomy.li: By the end of this we'll be too tired to eat.

warm.li: I'll do it. But please don't make this a habit.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: rationing
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Smaller portions for everyone. The food stores last a good deal longer, but most colonists resent going hungry. Ascetics approve; gourmands and the greedy hate it.

effects.li: Everyone gets hungry 25% more slowly, so food lasts longer.
Ascetics approve; most others mind, and gourmands and the greedy hate it.

plain.li: Better hungry now than starving in winter.

gloomy.li: I was hungry most days already. Not much changes for me.

plain.li: Half a bowl. I'm supposed to work all day on half a bowl.
I can hear my stomach from across the room.

blunt.li: Cut my food and see how fast I work.

cheerful.li: Smaller bowls? Then I'll eat slowly and make mine last!

warm.li: Give my share to the children. I'll manage.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: drills
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Daily weapons drills for everyone who can fight. Shooting and melee improve steadily while other work slows. Most colonists find it exhausting, but the bloodthirsty love it.

effects.li: Everyone who can fight practices shooting and melee every waking hour.
The bloodthirsty, tough and brawlers enjoy it; the wimpy and the kind hate it.

plain.li: Next raid, they'll find us ready.

blunt.li: About time somebody taught you lot which end goes bang.

cheerful.li: Target practice! I'm painting faces on the targets.

plain.li: I came here to farm, not to march.

warm.li: I don't want to get good at this. I really don't.

gloomy.li: All this practice, and the raiders will still have more guns.

cold.li: Training a cook to shoot is an inefficient use of a cook.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: study hours
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Evenings of lessons and reading for everyone. Skills improve faster and research picks up, but other work slows. Most colonists find it tedious; thinkers love it and brawlers hate it.

effects.li: Everyone learns 30% faster and researches 20% faster.
Those with a passion for intellectual work like it; brawlers hate it.

plain.li: I've been waiting years for someone to make everyone read.

cheerful.li: School for grown-ups! I'll bring the chalk.

cold.li: Skills compound. This is an investment.

plain.li: I didn't survive a crash landing to sit through lectures.

gloomy.li: The more I read about medicine, the more I find to worry about.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: austerity
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: The council takes no new wishes while it lasts, and everyone makes do with what they have. Standards fall quickly, so colonists are easier to please afterward. Ascetics love it; the greedy and jealous hate it.

effects.li: No new wishes while it lasts.
Everyone's standards drop quickly, so the council's rewards count for more again.
Ascetics love it; the greedy and jealous hate it.

plain.li: We've been living soft. Some hardship will do us good.

cold.li: Expectations had become unsustainable. This corrects them.

warm.li: We have each other. That's enough for a while.

plain.li: So we're not allowed to want things now.

gloomy.li: I knew the good times wouldn't last. I didn't think we'd cancel them on purpose.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: festival days
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: A few days of rest, music and late nights. Moods lift and all work slows down. Useful when the colony is close to breaking, but standards rise while it lasts, so don't make it a habit.

effects.li: Everyone's mood lifts; the lazy are overjoyed.

plain.li: Nobody touch a shovel for three days. That's an order.

cheerful.li: A festival! I've been practicing my dancing, badly.

gloomy.li: Fine. A few good days before whatever comes next.

warm.li: We've earned this, all of us.

cold.li: Three days of lost output. I hope the mood is worth it.
